## Hypothesis

We hypothesize that adjusting the take-profit, stop-loss, time stop, strike offset, chandelier arm, and volatility ratio threshold in the SHOTGUN_SCALPER Stage-4 framework can improve edge capture on J's anchor days by better aligning exits with trade quality and volatility regimes. The current combo aims to take profits earlier (75% premium gain) and tighten stops (35% premium loss) to reduce loser impact while maintaining winner capture.

## Mechanism

**Entry logic:** HTF-gated directional scoring from SHOTGUN_SCALPER Stage-4 (288-combo sweep baseline).  
**Exit logic:**  
- Take-profit: exit 66.7% of position at +75% premium gain (`tp_premium_pct=0.75`)  
- Stop-loss: exit remaining position at -35% premium (`stop_premium_pct=-0.35`) or 12-minute time stop (`time_stop_min=12`), whichever comes first  
- Strike selection: ATM + 2 strikes (`strike_offset=2`) for bearish puts  
- Profit-lock: chandelier-style profit-lock arms at 60% of favorable move (`chandelier_arm_pct=0.6`) and trails 15% off high-water mark  
- Volatility filter: only enter when current volume > 1.2 × 20-bar average volume (`vol_ratio_threshold=1.2`)
